metadata.title: About Us
metadata.description: Learn more about the mission, vision, beliefs, and leadership behind The Wind Church in Riverside, CA.

mission.title: Mission
mission.subtitle: Honor the Lord, love God's people, and serve our generation.
mission.description: Our church mission is to honor the Lord by demonstrating our love for God and His people through dedicated service to our generation.

vision.title: Vision
vision.subtitle: Growing God's family through love, service, and discipleship.
vision.description: Our vision is to expand God's family through love, compassionate service, and committed discipleship, creating a nurturing environment where individuals grow in their faith and are equipped to make a positive impact in the world.

history.title: My History
history.description: From a young age, Pastor Singletary felt a profound calling to serve the Lord in an extraordinary way. This vision became a reality when he recommitted his life to Jesus Christ on June 26, 1998, and shortly after married his wife, Amber, in 2000. Together, they have faithfully served in various ministry roles, blessed with three wonderful children. Pastor Singletary served under Dr. Michael Edwards for 18 years, holding positions such as Associate Minister, Youth Pastor, Young Adult Facilitator, Children's Church Team member, Church Council Chairperson, Elder, and Assistant Pastor. His extensive experience and dedication prepared him for his current role as Senior Pastor.

why.title: Why I am a Pastor
why.description: Pastor Singletary's journey to becoming a pastor was rooted in a deep, early conviction to serve God and His people. His calling was solidified through years of faithful service and spiritual growth under the mentorship of Dr. Michael Edwards. He views his role as an awesome privilege and is committed to fulfilling God's purpose for The Wind.

goals.title: Future Goals
goals.description: Pastor Singletary is committed to both spiritual and educational growth. As a bi-vocational pastor, he encourages others to pursue knowledge and understanding. He holds a Bachelor's degree, three Master's degrees, and is currently pursuing a Doctorate of Ministry. His goal is to inspire others to serve God wholeheartedly and advance the Kingdom of God using their gifts and talents.

fact.title: Fun Fact
fact.description: Pastor Singletary often reminds his congregation that “We are a BATTLESHIP, not a CRUISESHIP!” This borrowed mantra reflects his belief that the church's mission is to serve and advance God's Kingdom, rather than seeking to be served. His messages are known for being practical, relevant, and inspiring, resonating with people of all backgrounds.

metadata.title: Learn About Foursquare
metadata.description: Discover the history, beliefs, and global mission of the International Church of the Foursquare Gospel.

Foursquare.title: Foursquare Gospel Church
Foursquare.subtitle: An international Pentecostal Christian denomination founded in 1923.

descriptions: The Wind Church (dba Wind of the Spirit) is part of a worldwide movement called the International Church of the Foursquare Gospel, with more than 1,700 churches in the United States and over 68,500 churches across more than 150 nations.
Every week, more than 12,000 men, women, boys, and girls accept Jesus Christ through the preaching of the gospel in Foursquare churches around the world.

The name “Foursquare” is unique compared to most church names. It was born out of an extraordinary move of God during the early 20th century—a period marked by revolutionary changes throughout the world.

A great revival swept across the Western world as the 1900s began. Its impact grew as believers in various places were filled with the Holy Spirit, experiencing something similar to the events of Acts 2 on the Day of Pentecost. This movement became known as the “Pentecostal Movement.”

By the 1920s, some felt that Pentecostals were becoming extreme in their beliefs. A divide began forming between older denominations and the new groups emerging from revival meetings. Into this unusual moment stepped a woman evangelist, Aimee Semple McPherson, who began preaching the “Foursquare Gospel.” Born in Ingersoll, Ontario, Canada, she came to faith at age 17. Shortly after, she married Robert Semple—the young preacher whose message led to her conversion. The couple soon left for China, where Robert gave his life in service to God. Aimee returned to America as a widow with her young daughter and eventually remarried. Yet the call to preach continued to stir in her heart. She resisted it, longing for a “normal life,” but restlessness grew. When sickness brought her near death, she sensed God asking, “Will you go and preach?” Her surrender—“Yes, Lord, I will go”—became the beginning of a lifelong ministry.

Her worldwide ministry led to countless lives being redeemed, miraculously healed, baptized in water, and filled with the Holy Spirit. Thousands from every denomination—and many with no church background at all—attended her meetings. Those whose lives were transformed came to feel like part of the Foursquare family.

On September 27, 1944, God called His handmaiden home. The night before, she preached a message in Oakland, California—the very city where she first received the vision of the Foursquare Gospel. A cycle had come full circle, and a divine assignment had been completed.

Foursquare International continues to reflect the heart of our founder and the Great Commission given by our Lord: to go into all the world and preach the gospel to everyone. Evangelism and world missions remain the very heartbeat of the Foursquare Church.
Just a few of the ministries of the Foursquare Church:
Foursquare Missionary Press distributes more than 3,000,000 pieces of evangelistic literature each year.
National Youth Ministry.

L.I.F.E. Pacific Colleges are accredited Bible colleges located in San Dimas, California; Christiansburg, Virginia; and Burnaby, British Columbia. Many additional Bible institutes operate in partnership with local Foursquare churches around the world. Foursquare Women International is a service organization made up of more than 10,000 members.
Christian Education.
Foursquare World Advance — a bimonthly magazine highlighting the global Foursquare family.
Eight camping facilities.
And much more.

The Foursquare community has no desire to compete or compare. We rejoice with every body of believers which lifts the blodstained banner of Jesus Christ. The foursqaure Church is a memeber of the Nartional Association of Evangelicals (NAE) and, as a Pentecostal Church, is affliated with the Pentecoastal-Charismatic Churches of (North America 9PCCNA) and the Penetecoastl World Fellowship.
You may request a free subscription by writing to Foursquare World Advance, P.O. Box 26902, 1910 W. Sunset Blvd., Suite 200, Los Angeles, California 90026-0176.
For more information about the International Church of the Foursquare Gospel (ICFG), visit <link>www.foursquare.org</link>.

descriptions: The term “Foursquare” refers to the four-fold ministry of Jesus Christ.
<bold>Crown</bold> — Symbolic of Jesus Christ, the Soon-Coming King
<bold>Cross</bold> — Symbolic of Jesus Christ, our Savior
<bold>Cup</bold> — Symbolic of Jesus Christ, the Great Physician (Healer)
<bold>Dove</bold> — Symbolic of Jesus Christ, the Baptizer with the Holy Spirit
Matthew 8:17
Matthew 1:21
1 Thessalonians 4:16-18
Matthew 3:11
Matthew 4:23
John 3:16
Matthew 24:30-31

The concept of “Foursquare” appears both implicitly and explicitly throughout the Old and New Testaments. One of the clearest examples is found in Ezekiel's vision (Ezekiel 1:10): “Each of the four had the face of a man, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and each also had the face of an eagle.”
<bold>Face of an Eagle</bold> — Symbolic of Jesus Christ, the Coming King
<bold>Face of an Ox</bold> — Symbolic of Jesus Christ, the Burden-Bearer
<bold>Face of a Man</bold> — Symbolic of Jesus Christ, who shared in human suffering
<bold>Face of a Lion</bold> — Symbolic of Jesus Christ, the Lion of Judah, the All-Powerful One
Ezekiel 1:1-28
Revelation 4:7
Israel is a type of the Foursquare Gospel: a foursquare altar of the finest gold, attended by a priest wearing a foursquare breastplate embroidered in scarlet, gold, blue, and purple.
<bold>Scarlet</bold> — Represents the first cardinal doctrine: Jesus Christ the Savior. Its emblem is the face of a man.
<bold>Gold</bold> — Represents the second cardinal doctrine: Jesus Christ the Baptizer with the Holy Spirit. Its emblem is the face of a lion.
<bold>Blue</bold> — Represents the third cardinal doctrine: Jesus Christ the Great Physician. Its emblem is the face of an ox.
<bold>Purple</bold> — Represents the fourth cardinal doctrine: Jesus Christ the Coming King. Its emblem is the face of an eagle.
Exodus 28:15-16

items.title: How can I donate online through PushPay?
items.description: Donating online is simple! Just visit our Give page, select the amount you'd like to give, choose a fund, and complete your secure transaction through PushPay. You can give a one-time gift or set up recurring donations for consistent support.

items.title: Is giving through PushPay secure?
items.description: Yes! PushPay uses industry-leading encryption and security measures to protect your financial information. Your online donation is processed safely, ensuring your contributions are handled with the utmost care.

items.title: Can I allocate my donation to a specific ministry or fund?
items.description: Absolutely! When you give online or in person, you can choose where your donation goes—whether it's general tithes, missions, youth programs, outreach, or another specific ministry. Simply select the designated fund when giving.

items.title: Can I set up automatic recurring donations?
items.description: Yes! PushPay allows you to schedule recurring donations on a weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly basis. This ensures consistent support for the church and makes giving effortless.

items.title: How do I give a donation in person or by mail?
items.description:
You can give during any of our services by placing your donation in the offering basket or drop box.

If you would prefer to mail a check, please send it to:

The Wind Church
6476 Streeter Avenue
Riverside, CA 92504

items.title: Will I receive a receipt for my donation?
items.description: Yes! When you give through PushPay, you'll receive an email confirmation immediately. For all donations—whether online, in person, or by mail—you will also receive an annual giving statement for tax purposes.

items.title: Can I update or cancel a recurring donation?
items.description: Of course! You can log into your PushPay account at any time to update your donation amount, change the frequency, or cancel a recurring gift.

items.title: Who can I contact if I have more questions about giving?
items.description: If you have any questions about donations, allocations, or giving statements, feel free to contact our finance team at +1 (951) 359-0203. We're happy to help!

scriptures.passage: So Christ himself gave the apostles, the prophets, the evangelists, the pastors and teachers, to equip his people for works of service, so that the body of Christ may be built up.
Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God's grace in its various forms.
Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage—with great patience and careful instruction.

Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters, since you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as a reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to indulge the flesh; rather, serve one another humbly in love
All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation.
Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
For just as each of us has one body with many members, and these members do not all have the same function, so in Christ we, though many, form one body, and each member belongs to all the others.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others.
Just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
The King will reply, 'Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, and he distributes them to each one, just as he determines.
For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

Salvation.title: Salvation
Salvation.subtitle: Jesus is here for you. Always.

what.title: What is Salvation?
what.description: Salvation is God's plan to provide man an escape from the consequences of sin. Being saved or born again is the most important experience in your life (John 3:3, 15, 16). When you confess Jesus as Lord and Savior, you experience the new birth. Every abundant blessing He has for us in freely available in salvation (Romans 10:9-10). The word salvation comes from the Greek word soteria, which means saved, healed, delivered, pardoned, rescued, protected, preserved, made whole, cured, set free, and restored.

how.title: How do you receive Salvation?
descriptions: God has made it really simple. Answer these four questions:

If you answered <bold>Yes</bold>, you are ready to pray. Remember God loves you. He wants you to be whole and complete or saved - spiritually, emotionally, physically, mentally, financially, and socially (3 John 2). Pray this prayer, mean it, and you will be saved, right where you are sitting.

questions.question: Do you believe Jesus Christ, God's son, died for you?

questions.question: Are you willing to repent of sin and follow the Lord Jesus Christ for the rest of your life?
questions.alt: Green olives on a branch attached to an olive tree.

questions.question: Do you believe in your heart and confess with your mouth that God does forgive you of your sins and that He does cleanse you from all unrighteousness?
questions.alt: A hand gently touching a river of water causing ripples.

prayer.title: Prayer of Salvation
descriptions: Father in heaven, thank you for sending your Son, Jesus, to die on the cross for me, and for His blood that was shed to redeem me and to cleanse me from my sins.

Lord, I am sorry and I repent of my sins. Forgive me. I understand that I must change the course of my life. I am determined in my heart to follow you. I invite you to become the Lord of my life from this point forward, forever.

I openly proclaim and confess that you are the Lord of my life. I believe in my heart that You have been raised from the dead. Therefore I am saved. I am a new creature. The old things have passed. All things have become new.
I am a child of God. In the Name of Jesus, AMEN!

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Let us tell you more about The Wind Youth services

items.question: What is the purpose of the Youth Service?
items.answer: Our Youth Service is designed to help young people encounter God, grow in their faith, and build strong relationships with peers. It's a dynamic and engaging environment where students can worship, learn biblical truths, and develop a Christ-centered foundation for life.

items.question: What age group is the Youth Service for?
items.answer: The Youth Service is open to students from toddler to high school. We tailor our messages, activities, and small groups to be relevant and impactful for each age group.

items.question: Is the teaching in Youth Service appropriate for my child?
items.answer: Absolutely! Our messages are biblically sound, age-appropriate, and designed to help students navigate real-life challenges through a faith-based perspective. We focus on topics like identity in Christ, friendships, purpose, and making wise choices.

items.question: Will my child be safe during Youth Service?
items.answer: Yes! The safety of your child is our top priority. All youth leaders and volunteers undergo background checks and training to create a secure and welcoming environment. We also have clear safety policies in place for check-in and check-out.

items.question: What if my child is nervous about attending?
items.answer: That's completely understandable! Many students feel unsure when trying something new. Our youth team is welcoming, and we'll make sure your child feels comfortable and included from the moment they arrive.

items.question: What can my child expect during a Youth Service?
items.answer: A typical service includes live worship, an engaging message, small group discussions, and interactive activities. We aim to create a fun and faith-filled atmosphere where students can grow spiritually and make new friends.

items.question: How can I stay involved as a parent?
items.answer: We encourage parents to stay connected by attending parent meetings, signing up for youth service updates, and talking with their child about what they're learning. You're also welcome to volunteer or participate in special events throughout the year!
